settings.externalTerminal: I have an external card terminal
settings.externalTerminalHint: Bank, Clip, Getnet… You charge on your terminal and record the sale with "Card". Without an external terminal or Mercado Pago Point, "Card" stays locked at the POS.

0.title: Create an app in Mercado Pago
0.body: Go to mercadopago.com.mx/developers with the SAME account your terminal is linked to. Go to «Tus integraciones» → «Crear aplicación». Give it a name (for example "SYMVORA"), choose «Pagos presenciales» and, as the product, «Point».

1.title: Copy the production Access Token
1.body: In your app open «Credenciales de producción» and copy the «Access Token» (it starts with APP_USR-). Test credentials don't work with a real terminal.

2.title: Set up the webhook
2.body: In your app go to «Webhooks» → «Configurar notificaciones», tab «Modo productivo». Paste this URL, check the «Order (Mercado Pago)» event and save. Then copy the «Clave secreta» shown on that same screen.

3.title: Paste both keys here and save
3.body: Access Token and Webhook secret go in the fields above. Press "Save": they're stored encrypted.

4.title: Choose your terminal
4.body: With the terminal on and online, press "Test connection": it shows up in the list. Choose it and press "Test connection" again; SYMVORA switches it to Point of Sale (PDV) mode. Restart the terminal so it takes the change.

5.title: Turn it on and charge
5.body: Turn on "Enable terminal" and save. At the POS choose "Card (terminal)": the amount goes straight to the terminal. If the charge already appeared on the terminal and you want to cancel it, cancel it on the terminal.

0.if: The terminal doesn't show up when testing the connection
0.then: The app was created with a different Mercado Pago account, or the terminal is off or offline.

1.if: The POS keeps "waiting" even though they paid
1.then: The webhook is missing or the secret doesn't match: check step 3 and paste the key again.

2.if: The terminal doesn't receive the charge
2.then: It isn't in PDV mode: repeat step 5 and restart it.

welcome.title: Welcome to SYMVORA!
welcome.description: This tutorial will guide you through setting up and using your point of sale system. Follow each step in order so everything works correctly.

equipo.title: Welcome to SYMVORA!
equipo.description: This tutorial shows you what you need for your shift: open the register, sell, and close it at the end of the day.

business.title: Set up your business
business.description: Start by setting up your business details: name, logo, brand color and tax information. They are used on receipts and in the look of the system.

users.title: Invite your team
users.description: If more people will use the system (cashiers, another administrator), add them here before you start selling. That way every sale records who made it.

suppliers.title: Add your suppliers
suppliers.description: This step is required: you can't record purchases without a supplier. Add your main suppliers here before continuing.

equipo.title: Record the purchases you receive
equipo.description: Here you log the goods that arrive from your suppliers, so inventory updates when you receive them.

products.title: Build your product catalog
products.description: This is the most important module. Here you define each product with its name, price, cost, unit of measure and barcode. Sales, purchases and inventory all depend on it.

equipo.title: Browse the catalog
equipo.description: Here you see each product with its price, stock and barcode. Use it to answer customer questions.

createProduct.title: Create your first product
createProduct.description: Click 'Add product' to create one. Set the name, sale price, purchase cost, unit of measure and barcode. You can turn on variants (size/color) or batches (expiration) if your business needs them.

openCash.title: Open the cash register
openCash.description: Before selling, open a cash register with a starting float. Without an open register, sales are not recorded as cash movements and the end-of-day count won't match.

firstSale.title: Make your first sale
firstSale.description: Search for a product by name or barcode, add it to the cart, choose a payment method (cash, card, transfer or credit) and complete the sale. Stock is deducted automatically.

closeCash.title: Close the register at the end of the day
closeCash.description: When your shift ends, enter the actual counted balance. The system compares it with the expected balance and shows you the difference, if any.

reports.title: Check your reports
reports.description: On the dashboard you can see today's and this month's sales, average ticket, best-selling products and payment methods.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.description: Here you can see who did what and when: creations, edits and deletions. It's your audit tool to check whether something went differently than expected.

billing.title: Manage your subscription
billing.description: Check your subscription status, add payment methods and review your payment history. Your plan is SYMVORA Basic at $399 MXN/month with a {dias}-day trial.

advancedSettings.title: Advanced settings
advancedSettings.description: In the "Modules" tab of Settings you turn features on or off for your business: variants, batches, shrinkage, credit and more. You can change this at any time.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Use Cmd+K (or Ctrl+K) to open quick search. You can go to any module, search for products and run actions without using the mouse.

complete.title: Tutorial complete!
complete.description: You now know SYMVORA's main modules. Remember the right order: Settings → Suppliers → Products → Open register → Sell. If you need help, click 'Need help?' in the top bar.

equipo.title: Tutorial complete!
equipo.description: You now know what you need for your shift: Open register → Sell → Close register. To go over it again, click 'View tutorial' in the top bar.

faq.title: Answers to common questions
faq.subtitle: The questions we hear most before getting started. If you have any other, message us on WhatsApp.

1.question: Do I need special equipment or a barcode scanner?
1.answer: No. You can start with just your phone, tablet or computer. If you already have a USB barcode scanner, it's also compatible. And if you don't have one, your phone's camera works as a scanner from the app.

2.question: Can I use it on my phone, tablet or computer?
2.answer: Yes. SYMVORA works on any device with a modern browser and internet: iOS, Android, Windows, macOS and Linux. You don't need to install anything — open it from your browser and you're set.

3.question: What happens when my {dias}-day free trial ends?
3.answer: After {dias} days, your subscription renews automatically to the current plan ($399 MXN/month) and is charged to the payment method you registered at signup. If you don't want to continue, you can cancel anytime before the charge at no cost.

4.question: Do I need technical knowledge to set it up?
4.answer: No. Once you enter the dashboard, a guided tutorial with floating windows walks you through everything (15 steps: welcome, your business, users, products, POS, finances, and more). If you close it, you can reopen it anytime from the ? button in the header. Plus, you have Spanish-language support via WhatsApp and email.

5.question: Is there a per-sale commission?
5.answer: No. SYMVORA charges a flat monthly subscription of $399 MXN regardless of the number of transactions. What you sell is yours — no hidden fees, no per-sale percentage.

7.question: Is my data secure?
7.answer: Yes. Each business operates in its own isolated database (Total Data Isolation). Your information is never mixed or visible to other tenants. Plus, every action is logged in an audit trail.

8.question: Can I cancel anytime?
8.answer: Yes. No penalties and no long-term contracts. If you cancel, you keep access until the end of the period you already paid for. We don't offer refunds for partial periods.

9.question: Is there a limit on users or products?
9.answer: No. You can add your whole team and your whole catalog at no extra cost: the subscription price is the same whether you have 1 or 20 users, and 50 or 5,000 products. We don't charge sales commissions either.
